overall_notes: The paper proposes a novel method (MuSC) for improving complex instruction following in LLMs through multi-granularity self-contrastive training. Evaluation is primarily conducted using GPT-4 as a judge across multiple benchmarks, with limited human evaluation focused solely on toxicity detection. No traditional automatic metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, etc.) are used.
